'When this defends, you may charge your hero's soul. If a yellow card is charged this way, draw a card. Blade Break' -- Blade Break is printed and fires from the card DB, deliberately not authored.

THE CHARGE IS A MAY WITH A COST, not an ability-level `additional_cost`. interpreter._run_ability pays additional_costs on EVERY dispatch and returns early once they cannot be paid, before conditions and before effects -- fine for a PLAY ability, which is dispatched once, and wrong for a trigger that fires on every defence (tests/test_costs_are_not_repaid.py). A MAY asks, and pays only when the player accepts, once per trigger.

'IF A YELLOW CARD IS CHARGED THIS WAY' is CHARGED_THIS_WAY, which reads what the cost just charged rather than the soul as a whole -- a soul that already held a yellow card would otherwise satisfy the gate every time.
